scripts.dev: npm run build -w @selfnote/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev -w @selfnote/server" "npm run dev -w @selfnote/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @selfnote/shared && npm run build -w @selfnote/server && npm run build -w @selfnote/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @selfnote/shared && npm run build -w @selfnote/server && node apps/server/test/integration.mjs
